title: TimeParameters
description: The temporal frame of an algorithm run: how long a timestep is, how far ahead to look, and when the run is scheduled.

timestep_minutes.description: Length of one timestep, in minutes.

horizon_hours.description: Length of the optimisation or forecast horizon, in hours.

scheduling_time.description: Time at which the optimisation / scheduling is executed.

hasActor.description: Actor these parameters belong to, where actor-specific.
